description: An emulation of tape that a machine has chewed up: the sound drops out and dulls in bursts, at a rate and a severity you set

params.text: Sets how badly the chewed sections are damaged, which is both how hard the dropout bites and how far the treble is rolled off during one
Sets how often the chewed sections come round; at the left there are none at all, and at the right the tape is chewed the whole time
Sets how much the gaps between chewed sections vary in length; at the left they are evenly spaced and at the right their lengths are scattered

notes: all three knobs come up fully anticlockwise, and with the frequency knob there nothing is chewed at all, so a new module passes the audio through unchanged.
how long each burst lasts and how long the gaps are is drawn at random inside the bounds the three knobs set, so two modules on the same signal never chew it in the same places.
the module has no menu of its own beyond Rack's.

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
